content.value_statement: API teams often need consistent specs, guides, examples, and maintenance steps. This skill provides a staged workflow for OpenAPI documentation, developer guides, examples, portals, and quality gates.
actual_capabilities: Guides endpoint discovery, request and response documentation, authentication notes, error codes, and rate limits.
Organizes OpenAPI specification work across paths, schemas, security settings, and examples.
Structures developer guides with getting started steps, authentication guidance, common patterns, troubleshooting, and FAQ content.
Plans code examples, SDK examples, curl examples, tutorials, and example testing.
Covers interactive documentation setup with Swagger UI, Redoc, try-it flows, and deployment checks.
Defines maintenance actions such as auto-generation, validation, review process, update schedules, and feedback monitoring.
limitations: It is a workflow guide, not a full OpenAPI parser or validator.
It references other skills that may not exist in every environment.
It does not deploy documentation sites by itself.
It does not replace technical review of generated examples or security descriptions.

use_cases.title: Launch New API Docs
use_cases.description: Create a complete documentation plan for a new API before public release.

use_cases.title: Standardize Existing Docs
use_cases.description: Turn scattered endpoint notes into a consistent OpenAPI spec and developer guide.

use_cases.title: Maintain Developer Portals
use_cases.description: Build a repeatable process for examples, validation, interactive docs, and scheduled updates.

prompt_templates.title: Inventory Endpoints
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner starting an API documentation project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to inventory my API endpoints. Identify request fields, response fields, authentication, error codes, and rate limits.

prompt_templates.title: Draft OpenAPI Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate user preparing a formal specification.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to plan an OpenAPI specification for my service. Include paths, schemas, security definitions, examples, and missing information.

prompt_templates.title: Create Developer Guide Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to create a developer guide outline. Include getting started, authentication, common patterns, troubleshooting, FAQ, and example requests.

prompt_templates.title: Design Full Documentation Program
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced user coordinating a docs portal and maintenance process.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to design a full API documentation program. Include OpenAPI work, examples, interactive docs, site structure, validation, review steps, and maintenance cadence.

output_examples.input: Document a payments API from route notes and authentication details.
output: Endpoint inventory grouped by resource and action.
OpenAPI work plan with schemas, examples, and security definitions.
Developer guide outline with onboarding, authentication, and troubleshooting sections.

output_examples.input: Improve a developer portal that has outdated examples.
output: Example coverage checklist for common workflows.
Interactive documentation tasks for Swagger UI or Redoc.
Maintenance plan for validation, review, updates, and feedback monitoring.

output_examples.input: Prepare documentation before releasing a new partner API.
output: Quality gates for spec completeness, working examples, interactive docs, and deployment.
Suggested review sequence for product, engineering, and documentation owners.

best_practices: Start with endpoint discovery before writing guides or examples.
Validate every example against the current API behavior.
Keep OpenAPI specs, guides, and interactive docs updated together.
anti_patterns: Writing guides before confirming endpoints, authentication, and error behavior.
Publishing examples that were not tested against the API.
Treating documentation launch as complete without a maintenance process.

faq.question: Does this skill generate a complete OpenAPI file automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides a workflow for planning and creating the specification with supporting skills or tools.

faq.question: Can it help with both public and internal APIs?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow applies to public, partner, and internal APIs that need clear developer documentation.

faq.question: Does it include interactive documentation steps?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes tasks for Swagger UI, Redoc, try-it functionality, testing, and deployment checks.

faq.question: What inputs work best?
faq.answer: Endpoint lists, route files, existing docs, authentication rules, error codes, examples, and product requirements work best.

faq.question: Does it replace an API security review?
faq.answer: No. It can document security behavior, but engineering and security teams should still review the API.

faq.question: Can it support ongoing documentation maintenance?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow includes validation, review process, scheduled updates, and feedback monitoring.
